slices.title: Gated read_provider_action tool, off by default (code half)
slices.summary: Adds one read-only tool, read_provider_action, with a closed operation enum, a per-operation field whitelist, typed statuses, paging and a 12000-character cap, off by default behind PROVIDER_READ_TOOL_ENABLED. It is refused under ZDR and Space and offered only for a selected connection (K3-15: no default-all in Do; the selection field lands in S4). A connector read with screening taint or a Flagged result pauses web_fetch and execute_provider_action with the WS13 tainted_egress cause.
slices.remaining: Code half: Gated read_provider_action tool, off by default, with mocked-provider tests and the tainted_egress pause test.
